Properties.Description: FAST Channels agent tools
Properties.Name: fast-tools

Mcp.Instructions: FAST Channels operations: catalog, media library, Channel Assembly origins, schedules, channels and encoding ladders. Tools validate and do all arithmetic; approval-gated tools change what airs or what is billed.

Properties.Description: Agent tools: reference catalog search
Properties.Name: catalog

InlinePayload.Description: Find titles to schedule. Filters combine with AND; genres and ratings match any listed value. Results are paged with next_token.

InputSchema.Description: Catalog search: free text plus genre/rating filters; all criteria are combined with AND.

correlation_id.Description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

text.Description: Words to match in title or synopsis.

InlinePayload.Name: search_content

InlinePayload.Description: Full metadata of one title, including cue points, rights window and assets.

correlation_id.Description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

InlinePayload.Name: get_content

Properties.Description: Agent tools: linear channels and their playback configurations
Properties.Name: channels

InlinePayload.Description: List the deployment's channels: live state (RUNNING is billed by the hour), owner, tier, ladder version and outputs. channels___get_channel adds the playback URLs and the auto-stop time.

correlation_id.Description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

owner.Description: Only channels of this owner (one of iac, agent).

InlinePayload.Name: list_channels

InlinePayload.Description: Get one channel: live state, owner, tier, ladder version, outputs, the viewer playback URL per output (SSAI; per CDN when several are configured) and the pending auto-stop time. Give operators these URLs verbatim; never build playback URLs yourself.

channel.Description: Channel name from channels___list_channels (min length 1; max length 64).

correlation_id.Description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

InlinePayload.Name: get_channel

InlinePayload.Description: Start a channel so viewers can watch it. It is billed per hour while running (BASIC ~$0.10/h, STANDARD ~$0.35/h) and is stopped automatically after the deployment's maximum runtime (auto_stop_at); starting a running channel only moves the auto-stop. A stopped channel first drops the programs whose planned start has passed, which would otherwise air late: they are returned in skipped (SKIPPED in the guide) with a hint to relay to the operator, and every later program airs at its planned time. Returns the channel's alerts: SCHEDULING_ERROR alerts break playback. Requires operator approval: calling it asks the operator, and it runs once they approve. Call it rather than asking for approval in text.

channel.Description: Channel name from channels___list_channels (min length 1; max length 64).

correlation_id.Description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

InlinePayload.Name: start_channel

InlinePayload.Description: Stop a channel: playback ends for every viewer and billing stops. Published programs stay in the schedule and the guide. When the channel is started again, the programs whose start has passed by then are skipped and the rest air at their planned times. Requires operator approval: calling it asks the operator, and it runs once they approve. Call it rather than asking for approval in text.

channel.Description: Channel name from channels___list_channels (min length 1; max length 64).

correlation_id.Description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

InlinePayload.Name: stop_channel

InlinePayload.Description: Create an agent-owned linear channel <prefix>-agent-<name> with its ad-insertion playback configuration (SSAI), logs and channel policy. The ladder version must be READY (encoding___list_ladders), and the channel airs only assets encoded with it. The channel is created STOPPED and costs nothing until channels___start_channel; fill it with schedule___plan and schedule___publish. Fails with QUOTA at the deployment's agent-channel limit and CONFLICT when the name is taken. Requires operator approval: calling it asks the operator, and it runs once they approve. Call it rather than asking for approval in text.

brief.Description: Programming brief every plan is checked against; omit for no rules (default break policy).

break_policy.Description: Ad-break policy of every plan on the channel; a plan can override it.

cadence_minutes.Description: Target minutes from the end of one ad break to the next, counted across programs (default 12; > 0).

end_margin_seconds.Description: No break this close to a program's end, unless the asset has editorial cue points (default 30; ≥ 0).

max_breaks.Description: Most breaks per program; omit for no limit (≥ 0).

min_gap_minutes.Description: Minimum minutes between the end of one break and the next break; omit for half the cadence (≥ 0).

min_program_minutes.Description: Programs shorter than this get no breaks, unless the asset has editorial cue points (default 3; ≥ 0).

slate_gops.Description: Break length in GOPs, one of 15, 30, 45, 60: about 30, 60, 90 or 120 s with 2 s GOPs (default 30).

start_margin_seconds.Description: No break this close to a program's start, unless the asset has editorial cue points (default 60; ≥ 0).

dayparts.Description: Extra rules for programs that start inside UTC time-of-day windows.

Items.Description:
A UTC time-of-day window (`start` inclusive, `end` exclusive, may wrap midnight) with content rules.

Programs *starting* inside the window must match `ratings` and `genres` when those are non-empty.

end.Description: UTC end of the window, HH:MM (exclusive); may wrap past midnight, equal to start means all day (pattern ^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$).

genres.Description: A program starting in the window needs one of these genres; empty adds no genre rule.

ratings.Description: Ratings allowed for programs starting in the window; empty adds no rating rule.

start.Description: UTC start of the window, HH:MM (inclusive; pattern ^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$).

genres_allow.Description: A program needs at least one of these genres; empty allows every genre.

genres_deny.Description: Programs with any of these genres are refused.

notes.Description: Free-text guidance for the agent; the tools do not check it.

ratings.Description: Allowed content ratings, e.g. TV-G and TV-PG; empty allows every rating.

correlation_id.Description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

ladder_version.Description: READY ladder version (encoding___list_ladders); omit for the deployment default.

name.Description: Short name, e.g. kids; the channel is named <prefix>-agent-<name> (pattern ^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,22}[a-z0-9])?$).

outputs.Description: Outputs (rendition profiles) with renditions on the ladder, at most 5; omit for every package profile of the deployment.

tier.Description: BASIC ~$0.10/h, STANDARD ~$0.35/h while running (one of BASIC, STANDARD; default BASIC).

InlinePayload.Name: create_channel

InlinePayload.Description: Delete an agent-owned channel (<prefix>-agent-*): stop it, then remove its programs, guide, playback configuration and log deliveries. Cannot be undone. Channels defined by the deployment (owner iac) cannot be deleted; stop them instead. Requires operator approval: calling it asks the operator, and it runs once they approve. Call it rather than asking for approval in text.

channel.Description: Channel name from channels___list_channels (min length 1; max length 64).

correlation_id.Description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

InlinePayload.Name: delete_channel

Properties.Description: Agent tools: encoding ladders and their kits
Properties.Name: encoding

InlinePayload.Description: List encoding ladder versions with status, top resolution, rendition count, encode cost per content-minute and kit (filler and break slates, house ads). Channels need a READY version; ingest also accepts a PROVISIONING one.

correlation_id.Description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

status.Description: Only ladder versions in this status (one of PROPOSED, PROVISIONING, READY, FAILED).

InlinePayload.Name: list_ladders

InlinePayload.Description: Get one ladder version in full: every rendition (names for propose_ladder's drop_rungs), audio, frame rate, GOP/segment grid, options, manifest profiles, kit and provisioning status or error.

correlation_id.Description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

ladder_version.Description: Ladder version from encoding___list_ladders, e.g. standard@86bf8088e0 (min length 3).

InlinePayload.Name: get_ladder

InlinePayload.Description: Propose a new ladder version derived from a base version: cap or floor the height, shift quality, drop rungs. Changes nothing. Returns a proposal_id (valid 24 hours), the diff, validation errors and warnings, the encode cost per content-minute and the kit cost. Show it all to the operator; only a valid proposal they accept goes to encoding___provision_ladder.

base.Description: Ladder version to derive from, e.g. standard@86bf8088e0 (min length 3).

correlation_id.Description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

ops.Description: Changes to apply to the base; every field is optional and they combine.

drop_rungs.Description: Video rendition names to drop, e.g. avc-360p (encoding___get_ladder lists them).

max_height.Description: Drop video renditions taller than this many lines, e.g. 720 (> 0).

min_height.Description: Drop video renditions shorter than this many lines (> 0).

new_id.Description: Ladder id of the result (its version is <id>@<fingerprint>); omit to keep the base id (max length 24; pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$).

quality_shift.Description: Added to every rendition's QVBR quality level (1-10, clamped); higher is better quality and more bits (default 0; ≥ -2; ≤ 2).

InlinePayload.Name: propose_ladder

InlinePayload.Description: Provision a proposed ladder version: create its MediaConvert job template and encode its kit (filler slate, break slates, house ads and ad pod) with it. Costs the kit encode (kit_cost_usd of the proposal) and takes minutes: poll encoding___get_ladder until READY. Only then can channels___create_channel use the version, and content must be ingested with it (library___ingest) to air on such a channel. Nothing is started when the version is already PROVISIONING or READY. Requires operator approval: calling it asks the operator, and it runs once they approve. Call it rather than asking for approval in text.

correlation_id.Description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

proposal_id.Description: proposal_id of a valid proposal from encoding___propose_ladder (min length 3).

InlinePayload.Name: provision_ladder

Properties.Description: Agent tools: media library and ingest
Properties.Name: library

InlinePayload.Description: List library assets matching every given filter (kind, status, ladder_version, content_id), one compact row each, paged with next_token. Use it to find READY content encoded with a channel's ladder version before planning, or to see what is still ingesting; library___get_asset has the full asset.

content_id.Description: Only encodes of this catalog title (max length 64).

correlation_id.Description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

kind.Description: content = schedulable programs, slate = break and filler slates, ad = house-ad creatives (one of content, slate, ad).

ladder_version.Description: Only encodes with this ladder version; a channel airs only assets of its own ladder (pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*@[0-9a-f]{10}$).

limit.Description: Maximum number of assets to return (default 50; ≥ 1; ≤ 100).

next_token.Description: next_token from the previous page; omit for the first page.

status.Description: READY assets can be scheduled; INGESTING and ENCODED are still in the pipeline (one of INGESTING, ENCODED, READY, FAILED).

InlinePayload.Name: find_assets

InlinePayload.Description: Get one asset in full: its valid ad-break offsets (ms), VOD source, package paths, the other ladder versions it is encoded with, and the ingest error if it FAILED.

correlation_id.Description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

ladder_version.Description: Which encode; omit for the deployment default ladder, else the most recent encode (pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*@[0-9a-f]{10}$).

InlinePayload.Name: get_asset

InlinePayload.Description: Encode a mezzanine file into the media library with a ladder version (MediaConvert, billed per output minute). Encode with the ladder of the channel that will air it; pass the catalog duration_ms to get estimated_cost_usd. Cue points between segment boundaries make ad breaks frame-accurate with ESAM, at the Professional tier (about 1.6 times the Basic cost). Returns as soon as the ingest pipeline starts; poll library___get_ingest_status with the execution_name until done (minutes). Refuses assets already in the library unless they FAILED, and S3 sources outside the ingest bucket. Requires operator approval: calling it asks the operator, and it runs once they approve. Call it rather than asking for approval in text.

asset_id.Description: Library id; omit to derive a stable id from the file name (pattern ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,47}$).

content_id.Description: Catalog id of the title (min length 1; max length 64).

correlation_id.Description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

cue_points_ms.Description: Editorial ad-break positions in ms (catalog cue_points_ms); snapped to the nearest frame. A point between segment boundaries adds ESAM, which bills the encode at MediaConvert's Professional tier.

duration_ms.Description: Running time in ms (catalog duration_ms); only used for the cost estimate (> 0).

kind.Description: content for a program; ad for a house-ad creative (one of content, ad; default content).

ladder_version.Description: Ladder version to encode with (PROVISIONING or READY); omit for the deployment default (pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*@[0-9a-f]{10}$).

source_uri.Description: Mezzanine file: an object in the ingest bucket (s3://<ingest bucket>/<key>, case-sensitive, no spaces) or an https:// URL (max length 2048; pattern ^(s3|https)://\S+$).

title.Description: Display title recorded on the asset (max length 200).

InlinePayload.Name: ingest

InlinePayload.Description: Check an ingest: the pipeline run (status, error) and the library asset it produces (status, VOD source, duration, number of break offsets); done is true once the run has finished. Pass the execution_name from library___ingest, or the asset_id.

correlation_id.Description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

ladder_version.Description: Ladder version of the encode; omit for the default (pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*@[0-9a-f]{10}$).

InlinePayload.Name: get_ingest_status

Properties.Description: Agent tools: Channel Assembly source locations and VOD sources
Properties.Name: origins

InlinePayload.Description: List the Channel Assembly source locations of the account: this deployment's, those the agent created for operators' own buckets, and any others, with their bucket and segment delivery URL.

correlation_id.Description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

InlinePayload.Name: list_source_locations

InlinePayload.Description: Create a SigV4 Channel Assembly source location for an operator's S3 bucket holding pre-encoded content. Returns the bucket-policy statements the operator must apply before origins___register_vod_source can read the bucket; show them verbatim (the agent never edits bucket policies). Idempotent for the same name and bucket. Requires operator approval: calling it asks the operator, and it runs once they approve. Call it rather than asking for approval in text.

bucket.Description: The operator's S3 bucket, in this account and region (no dots: MediaTailor reads over virtual-hosted HTTPS). SSE-S3 encryption only; SSE-KMS manifests cannot be read (pattern ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$).

correlation_id.Description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

segment_delivery_url.Description: HTTPS base URL of the CDN that serves this bucket's objects at the same paths; players fetch content segments from it (pattern ^https://[^\s/?#]+(/[^\s?#]*)?$).

InlinePayload.Name: create_source_location

InlinePayload.Description: Register pre-encoded HLS content from a source location as a schedulable library asset (owner agent). Every manifest must match the ladder exactly (video codec, resolution, frame rate and muxed audio codec of every variant, in order; LADDER_MISMATCH otherwise) because Channel Assembly switches programs variant by variant. Duration and ad-break offsets are computed from the media playlists; the asset is READY at once.

asset_id.Description: Library id to give the content, e.g. acme-pilot (pattern ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,47}$).

content_id.Description: Catalog id of the title (min length 1; max length 64).

correlation_id.Description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

ladder_version.Description: Ladder the content must match; omit for the default (pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*@[0-9a-f]{10}$).

packages.Description: One HLS multivariant playlist per source group. A channel airs the asset only if every channel output has a package here (min items 1; max items 5).

path.Description: Manifest path relative to the source location base URL, e.g. /shows/pilot/main.m3u8 (pattern ^/\S+\.m3u8$).

source_group.Description: Rendition profile served under this name (a channel output), e.g. hls.

title.Description: Display title recorded on the asset (max length 200).

InlinePayload.Name: register_vod_source

InlinePayload.Description: Replace the source groups (rendition profiles) an asset's VOD source serves. Channel Assembly needs every program, slate and filler of a channel to serve every output of the channel, so add a group before a channel with that output airs the asset. Pass the complete new set. Requires operator approval: calling it asks the operator, and it runs once they approve. Call it rather than asking for approval in text.

asset_id.Description: Library asset whose VOD source changes (pattern ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,47}$).

correlation_id.Description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

ladder_version.Description: Which encode; omit for the deployment default (pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*@[0-9a-f]{10}$).

packages.Description: The complete new set of source groups; it replaces the current one (min items 1; max items 5).

path.Description: Manifest path; needed only for agent-registered content and a source group it does not serve yet, because pipeline encodes have every profile's manifest (pattern ^/\S+\.m3u8$).

source_group.Description: Rendition profile served under this name (a channel output), e.g. hls.

InlinePayload.Name: update_package_configurations

InlinePayload.Description: List Channel Assembly alerts of a channel (and its programs), a VOD source or a source location, most severe first. Check a channel after every schedule change and before starting it: SCHEDULING_ERROR alerts break playback. The expected SEGMENT_DURATION_MISMATCH and BANDWIDTH_MISMATCH warnings are left out (counted in suppressed) unless include_noise is set.

channel.Description: Channel name: alerts of the channel and its programs.

correlation_id.Description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

include_noise.Description: Also return SEGMENT_DURATION_MISMATCH and BANDWIDTH_MISMATCH, which are expected here (default false).

limit.Description: Maximum number of alerts to return, most severe first (default 50; ≥ 1; ≤ 100).

source_location.Description: Source location of vod_source (default: this deployment's); alone, the source location itself.

InlinePayload.Name: list_alerts

Properties.Description: Agent tools: channel schedules (plan, publish, EPG)
Properties.Name: schedule

InlinePayload.Description: Get a channel's published schedule from now on: programs with UTC start/end, title, rating, ad breaks and status (SKIPPED: removed unaired because the channel started late), the end of the schedule (end; schedule___plan appends there by default) and the filler gaps between programs.

channel.Description: Channel name from channels___list_channels (min length 1; max length 64).

correlation_id.Description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

InlinePayload.Name: get_schedule

InlinePayload.Description: Plan a block of programs on a channel; nothing changes on air. The picks air back to back in the given order from start, right after the program named in after, or by default where the published schedule ends (10 minutes from now when it is empty). Computes every start time, on-air duration (content plus ad breaks), ad break and SCTE-35 id, and checks the brief (ratings, genres, dayparts) and the schedule (overlaps, lead time). Returns a plan_id with the program table in UTC, the violations and publishable. Error violations block publishing: change the picks or the start and plan again; warnings are for the operator to accept. Publish with schedule___publish within the hour.

after.Description: Name of an upcoming program, from schedule___get_schedule, that the block starts right after.

break_policy.Description: Ad-break policy for this block only; omit to use the channel brief's.

cadence_minutes.Description: Target minutes from the end of one ad break to the next, counted across programs (default 12; > 0).

end_margin_seconds.Description: No break this close to a program's end, unless the asset has editorial cue points (default 30; ≥ 0).

max_breaks.Description: Most breaks per program; omit for no limit (≥ 0).

min_gap_minutes.Description: Minimum minutes between the end of one break and the next break; omit for half the cadence (≥ 0).

min_program_minutes.Description: Programs shorter than this get no breaks, unless the asset has editorial cue points (default 3; ≥ 0).

slate_gops.Description: Break length in GOPs, one of 15, 30, 45, 60: about 30, 60, 90 or 120 s with 2 s GOPs (default 30).

start_margin_seconds.Description: No break this close to a program's start, unless the asset has editorial cue points (default 60; ≥ 0).

channel.Description: Channel name from channels___list_channels (min length 1; max length 64).

correlation_id.Description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

picks.Description: Asset ids in air order: READY content encoded with the channel's ladder version (library___find_assets). An id listed twice airs twice (min items 1; max items 100).

start.Description: UTC ISO-8601 start of the block, e.g. 2026-10-16T18:00:00Z. Omit start and after to append to the published schedule (format date-time).

InlinePayload.Name: plan

InlinePayload.Description: Publish a plan to the channel's live schedule; this changes what airs. Takes only the plan_id of a publishable plan from schedule___plan (plans expire after an hour). Fails with PLAN_STALE when the schedule changed since planning: call schedule___get_schedule and plan again. Returns the published programs as guide entries and the channel's alerts. Requires operator approval: calling it asks the operator, and it runs once they approve. Call it rather than asking for approval in text.

correlation_id.Description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

plan_id.Description: plan_id returned by schedule___plan in this conversation (min length 3).

InlinePayload.Name: publish

InlinePayload.Description: Remove programs that have not started yet from a channel's live schedule and guide. Every other program keeps its planned start, so filler slate airs in their place. Programs that are on air or over are reported in not_found. Requires operator approval: calling it asks the operator, and it runs once they approve. Call it rather than asking for approval in text.

channel.Description: Channel name from channels___list_channels (min length 1; max length 64).

correlation_id.Description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

programs.Description: Names of upcoming programs to remove, from schedule___get_schedule (min items 1; max items 100).

InlinePayload.Name: remove_programs

InlinePayload.Description: Get a channel's programming brief: allowed ratings and genres, dayparts (UTC) and the ad-break policy that every plan is checked against. Read it before picking content.

channel.Description: Channel name from channels___list_channels (min length 1; max length 64).

correlation_id.Description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

InlinePayload.Name: get_brief

InlinePayload.Description: Replace a channel's programming brief, the standing rules every future plan is checked against. Pass the complete brief: start from schedule___get_brief and change only what the operator asked for. Requires operator approval: calling it asks the operator, and it runs once they approve. Call it rather than asking for approval in text.

brief.Description: The complete new brief; it replaces the current one.

break_policy.Description: Ad-break policy of every plan on the channel; a plan can override it.

cadence_minutes.Description: Target minutes from the end of one ad break to the next, counted across programs (default 12; > 0).

end_margin_seconds.Description: No break this close to a program's end, unless the asset has editorial cue points (default 30; ≥ 0).

max_breaks.Description: Most breaks per program; omit for no limit (≥ 0).

min_gap_minutes.Description: Minimum minutes between the end of one break and the next break; omit for half the cadence (≥ 0).

min_program_minutes.Description: Programs shorter than this get no breaks, unless the asset has editorial cue points (default 3; ≥ 0).

slate_gops.Description: Break length in GOPs, one of 15, 30, 45, 60: about 30, 60, 90 or 120 s with 2 s GOPs (default 30).

start_margin_seconds.Description: No break this close to a program's start, unless the asset has editorial cue points (default 60; ≥ 0).

dayparts.Description: Extra rules for programs that start inside UTC time-of-day windows.

Items.Description:
A UTC time-of-day window (`start` inclusive, `end` exclusive, may wrap midnight) with content rules.

Programs *starting* inside the window must match `ratings` and `genres` when those are non-empty.

end.Description: UTC end of the window, HH:MM (exclusive); may wrap past midnight, equal to start means all day (pattern ^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$).

genres.Description: A program starting in the window needs one of these genres; empty adds no genre rule.

ratings.Description: Ratings allowed for programs starting in the window; empty adds no rating rule.

start.Description: UTC start of the window, HH:MM (inclusive; pattern ^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$).

genres_allow.Description: A program needs at least one of these genres; empty allows every genre.

genres_deny.Description: Programs with any of these genres are refused.

notes.Description: Free-text guidance for the agent; the tools do not check it.

ratings.Description: Allowed content ratings, e.g. TV-G and TV-PG; empty allows every rating.

channel.Description: Channel name from channels___list_channels (min length 1; max length 64).

correlation_id.Description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.
